card.name: Leading digit before trailing zeros
card.fires_on: A digit in a round number (1, 5, 2, 3) written just before one or more zeros, such as the 5 in 50 mg or the 1 in 100. It is most common in dose amounts and volumes.

modes.label: Dose ranges
modes.description: The first digit of the upper number in a dose range, such as 25 mg to 50 mg.
modes.example: diphenhydramine (25 to <<5>>0 mg orally or intravenously)

modes.label: Single round amounts
modes.description: The first digit of a round amount in a dose, volume, or measurement.

card.plain: It fires on the digit just before the zeros in round numbers like 50 or 100, and it prepares the model to write a zero next.
